args.body: Use the committed SQLite verified-handoff as the delivery baseline for SQLITE-BUYER-REQUEST-PAID-DIAGNOSTIC. Reuse the existing captures or bounded result. Open no new general scan. If a saved original buyer brief already specifies an eligible discrete paid diagnostic, run a control tied to its acceptance wording and prepare an operator-ready proposal where the invited route and collection fit. If the capture allowance is exhausted without such a brief, close with the actual lease and a lesson covering what the existing search did establish and the exact original buyer evidence that would reopen it.
